exposure: Caesarean delivery for medical reasons vs. non-medical reasons
cohort: 13,015 pregnant women in six central urban districts of Tianjin, China
finding: Low physical activity increased the risk of caesarean delivery for medical reasons, while excessive sleep duration (≥9 h/day) increased the risk of both types of caesarean delivery, and their combined effect further increased the risk of caesarean delivery for medical reasons.
mod_finding: Low physical activity increased the risk of caesarean delivery for medical reasons, while excessive sleep duration increased the risk of both medical and non-medical caesarean deliveries.
